title: VLLM-LLAMA-RECIPES
summary: A repackaged deployment hub built on Meta's Llama Cookbook, providing recipes and a test harness (ai_runner.py) for running vLLM/Llama endpoints and workflows. One inherited cookbook notebook, evals_with_synthetic_data.ipynb, runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit synthetic tabular data for an LLM evaluation benchmark.
needs: This notebook appears to be carried over unchanged from meta-llama/llama-cookbook; the surrounding repo is a generic vLLM deployment wrapper unrelated to SDV.
